Namit Malhotra’s ‘Ramayana’ Vision Extends to Immersive Theme Park and Museum

Expanding the Epic

Producer Namit Malhotra has unveiled a 'Vision Video' for his upcoming cinematic adaptation of the Ramayana, detailing plans that extend beyond traditional filmmaking. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the project aims to create a cultural legacy by integrating immersive experiences, including a proposed theme park and museum alongside the film's theatrical release.

Project Scope and Timeline

The two-part epic stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana. Part 1 is scheduled for a worldwide release on November 5, 2026, with Part 2 following in 2027. While the video outlines ambitious plans for digital and physical engagement, the production team has not yet disclosed specific locations or construction timelines for the associated immersive spaces. Fans can view the vision teaser on JioHotstar.
